verdict.rationale: Firebase is a backend platform that hosts user data and offers AI features (Gemini in Firebase, Firebase AI Logic), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack has no documentation of any policy, setting, or control that keeps customer data out of model training. Security Rules (firebase-docs-10) govern data access permissions, which is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
